dialogues.jp: いつでも満開の桜。
dialogues.en: This cherry tree is always in full blossom.
dialogues.text: This cherry tree is always in full blossom.

dialogues.jp:
甘い匂いに包まれていて、風が吹くたびに梢が
心地よい音色を奏でる。
dialogues.en:
It's surrounded by sweet scents and it makes a pleasant
sound every time wind blows through it.
dialogues.text:
It's surrounded by sweet scents and it makes a pleasant
sound every time wind blows through it.

dialogues.jp:
それはまるで萌先輩の木琴のようにでたらめで、
この世のものとは思えない――。
dialogues.en:
I just can't believe this is real, it sounds just like
Moe-sempai's xylophone.
dialogues.text:
I just can't believe this is real, it sounds just like
Moe-sempai's xylophone.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、しくった」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god."
dialogues.text: "Oh my god."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ、なにが？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
今日は親子連れのノリで、手をつないで隣を歩
いていたさくらが俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura looked up at me as we held our hands together, like a
daughter meeting her father.
dialogues.text:
Sakura looked up at me as we held our hands together, like a
daughter meeting her father.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、詩作に失敗した」
dialogues.en: "I messed it up."
dialogues.text: "I messed it up."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「へいへい与作？」
dialogues.en: "What messed it up?"
dialogues.text: "What messed it up?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「詩作」
dialogues.en: "I was writing a poem."
dialogues.text: "I was writing a poem."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「シサク？　なにを試してるの？」
dialogues.en: "What, are you experimenting?"
dialogues.text: "What, are you experimenting?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「は？　俺がなにを試してるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What? What experiment?"
dialogues.text: "What? What experiment?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さぁ？　なんか靴の裏にでもつけてるの？」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know. Do you have something on the back of your
shoe?"
dialogues.text:
"I don't know. Do you have something on the back of your
shoe?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「靴の裏？」
dialogues.en: "What about the back of my shoe?"
dialogues.text: "What about the back of my shoe?"

dialogues.jp:
足を持ち上げてみるが、ガムもなんにもひっつ
いてはいない。
dialogues.en: I looked at the back of my shoe, but there was nothing.
dialogues.text: I looked at the back of my shoe, but there was nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
うたまるみたいに小首をかしげて、さくらが腕
を組む。
dialogues.en: Sakura folded her arms, tilting her head just like Nekomaru.
dialogues.text: Sakura folded her arms, tilting her head just like Nekomaru.

dialogues.jp:
「なにか話がずれてないか。なんの話をしてた
　んだ俺達は？」
dialogues.en: "Are we on the same subject? What are we talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Are we on the same subject? What are we talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え〜と、与作は日本人の心の鑑だよねって」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh...... was it about someone who would be a perfect
portrait of how the Japanese should be?"
dialogues.text:
"Ahh...... was it about someone who would be a perfect
portrait of how the Japanese should be?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「してねぇよ」
dialogues.en: "No way."
dialogues.text: "No way."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　お花見のときの桜吹雪は、芸者と遠
　山の銀さんに限るだっけ？」
dialogues.en:
"Or was it about who should be brought to a cherry blossom
viewing party?"
dialogues.text:
"Or was it about who should be brought to a cherry blossom
viewing party?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……普段から、なにをどう考えてるんだお前
　の脳みそは？」
dialogues.en: "I wonder how your brain works......"
dialogues.text: "I wonder how your brain works......"

dialogues.jp:
あまりのハイブリッド振りに思わず呟いてしま
う。
dialogues.en: I mumbled in disbelief.
dialogues.text: I mumbled in disbelief.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、シサクに失敗したって話だね。なんか
　研究でも始めたのお兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh yeah. It was about the experiment you messed up. What
are you experimenting about?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh yeah. It was about the experiment you messed up. What
are you experimenting about?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ようやく帰ってこれたなそこまで」
dialogues.en: "How could you come back after all that?"
dialogues.text: "How could you come back after all that?"

dialogues.jp: 思わず肩を落としてしまう。
dialogues.en: I dropped my shoulders.
dialogues.text: I dropped my shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
「分かった。試作じゃなくて、和歌とかの詩を
　考える詩作だ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, it's not an experiment, it's poem writing."
dialogues.text: "Okay, it's not an experiment, it's poem writing."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なんだぁ、そうなら詩作って最初から言って
　くれれば良いのに♪」
dialogues.en: "Why didn't you say so?"
dialogues.text: "Why didn't you say so?"

dialogues.jp: おばさんくさく、さくらが手を縦に振る。
dialogues.en: Sakura waved her hand up and down.
dialogues.text: Sakura waved her hand up and down.

dialogues.jp:
ここは、最初から言ってるだろと、ツッコミを
入れるべきところなんだろうか？
dialogues.en: "What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "What a pain......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「元気ないねぇ、お兄ちゃん。そういう時はあ
　そこ行こうよ！」
dialogues.en: "You don't look good. We should go there!"
dialogues.text: "You don't look good. We should go there!"

dialogues.jp: ぐぃ、と手を引っ張られる。
dialogues.en: She pulled my hand.
dialogues.text: She pulled my hand.

dialogues.jp: 「どこや？」
dialogues.en: "Where?"
dialogues.text: "Where?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクとお兄ちゃんの秘密基地」
dialogues.en: "Our secret hideout."
dialogues.text: "Our secret hideout."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、あの桜の木のところか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, that cherry tree?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, that cherry tree?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ね、いいでしょ？　お兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah! Do you want to go?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah! Do you want to go?"

dialogues.jp:
子供が駄々をこねるように、さくらが腕を引っ
張る。
dialogues.en: Sakura pulled my arm like a child.
dialogues.text: Sakura pulled my arm like a child.

dialogues.jp:
「いいでしょっ、て言うか、公園に行きたいな
　んておかしいと思ってたけど、元からそのつ
　もりだっただろう？」
dialogues.en:
"I thought it was kind of funny when you said you wanted to
go to the park. You've been planning on this, haven't you?"
dialogues.text:
"I thought it was kind of funny when you said you wanted to
go to the park. You've been planning on this, haven't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんのことやら、さっぱりぱりぱり」
dialogues.en: "I don't know what you're talking about."
dialogues.text: "I don't know what you're talking about."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「分かりやすすぎるぞ、おい」
dialogues.en: "You're way too predictable."
dialogues.text: "You're way too predictable."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボク、ニホンゴ、ワッカリマセ〜ン」
dialogues.en: "I don't understand Japanese."
dialogues.text: "I don't understand Japanese."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「久方ぶり、必殺｛ずがいこつ／頭蓋骨｝｛わし／鷲｝づかみ」
dialogues.en: "Take this! The head claw!"
dialogues.text: "Take this! The head claw!"

dialogues.jp:
頭を鷲づかみにした手を、そのままクレーンゲー
ムのように持ち上げる。
dialogues.en: I grabbed her head with my "claw" and lifted it up.
dialogues.text: I grabbed her head with my "claw" and lifted it up.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「痛たたたった！」
dialogues.en: "Ouch!!"
dialogues.text: "Ouch!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なんかパワーアップしてる〜！　ギブギブミー
　だよお兄ちゃん！」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I give in! You improved that move so much."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I give in! You improved that move so much."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まったく、なにが悲しくてお前と花見をせにゃ
　ならんのだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Why do I have to have a cherry blossom viewing party with
you?"
dialogues.text:
"Why do I have to have a cherry blossom viewing party with
you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクが嬉しいから花見をしようって言ってる
　んだよぉ……首がぬけるかと思ったにゃ……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm asking you because it makes me happy. I thought my head
would come off..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm asking you because it makes me happy. I thought my head
would come off..."

dialogues.jp: 頭を抱えてさくらがグルグルと首を回す。
dialogues.en:
I grabbed her head under my arm and she turned her head
around.
dialogues.text:
I grabbed her head under my arm and she turned her head
around.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、今日はそもそもお前に付き合うって約
　束だから構わないけどな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I don't mind, since I promised you yesterday that I'd
hang out with you."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I don't mind, since I promised you yesterday that I'd
hang out with you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「｛リアリー／本当｝？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「やった♪　今行こう、すぐ行こう、どんと行
　こう！」
dialogues.en: "That's great! Let's go, right now!"
dialogues.text: "That's great! Let's go, right now!"

dialogues.jp:
腕を抱きかかえられて、そのまま力ずくで引き
ずられる。
dialogues.en: She held my arm tightly and pulled me as hard as she can.
dialogues.text: She held my arm tightly and pulled me as hard as she can.

dialogues.jp: 「ま……ことりがいなきゃいいんだけどな」
dialogues.en: "I hope Kotori isn't there......"
dialogues.text: "I hope Kotori isn't there......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにか言った？」
dialogues.en: "What did you say?"
dialogues.text: "What did you say?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや……そういや懐かしい響きだな、秘密基
　地って」
dialogues.en:
"Never mind...... Doesn't the secret hideout bring back a
lot of memories?"
dialogues.text:
"Never mind...... Doesn't the secret hideout bring back a
lot of memories?"

dialogues.jp:
ぼんやりと呟いた声をかき消すように、さくら
が茂みをかきわけてズンズンと入っていく。
dialogues.en:
Sakura walked into the bushes, absorbing the sound of my
voice.
dialogues.text:
Sakura walked into the bushes, absorbing the sound of my
voice.

dialogues.jp: その音すら懐かしい。
dialogues.en: The rustle of the buses sounded so familiar.
dialogues.text: The rustle of the buses sounded so familiar.

dialogues.jp: そこは、俺とさくらと――音夢の秘密基地。
dialogues.en: It was still there-- our secret hideout.
dialogues.text: It was still there-- our secret hideout.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……とーちゃく」
dialogues.en: "Here we are."
dialogues.text: "Here we are."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、今朝の夢を思い出して辺りを見渡
してしまう。
dialogues.en: I looked around thinking about the dream I had this morning.
dialogues.text: I looked around thinking about the dream I had this morning.

dialogues.jp:
ここには幾つもの想い出があるが、そのどの瞬
間も、人が変わってもこの風景だけは同じ姿を
していた。
dialogues.en:
I have so many memories at this place, but no matter what
happened, this place always stays the same.
dialogues.text:
I have so many memories at this place, but no matter what
happened, this place always stays the same.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「帰ってきたよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm back."
dialogues.text: "I'm back."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
自分に話し掛けられたと思ったのだが、さくら
は枯れない桜を見上げて寂しく笑っていた。
dialogues.en:
I thought she said that to me, but Sakura was looking at the
everlasting cherry tree, smiling sadly.
dialogues.text:
I thought she said that to me, but Sakura was looking at the
everlasting cherry tree, smiling sadly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……帰ってきたよ。おばあちゃん」
dialogues.en: "I'm back, Grandma......"
dialogues.text: "I'm back, Grandma......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクは間違ってないよね」
dialogues.en: "I'm all right."
dialogues.text: "I'm all right."

dialogues.jp:
聞くつもりはなかったのだが、風向きのためか、
本当に小さな声なのに聞こえてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I didn't mean to listen to it, but I ended up hearing what
she said, even though it was a small voice. Maybe it was
because of the wind.
dialogues.text:
I didn't mean to listen to it, but I ended up hearing what
she said, even though it was a small voice. Maybe it was
because of the wind.

dialogues.jp: 「ばあちゃん、か」
dialogues.en: "Grandma......"
dialogues.text: "Grandma......"

dialogues.jp:
手の中に小さなあられを生み出して、口の中に
放り込む。
dialogues.en:
I made some small rice crackers in my hand and put one into
my mouth.
dialogues.text:
I made some small rice crackers in my hand and put one into
my mouth.

dialogues.jp:
忙しく働いていた両親の代わりに、俺や音夢、
さくらの面倒を見てくれた人。
dialogues.en:
She took care of Nemu, Sakura and me, taking the place of
our parents who were working all the time.
dialogues.text:
She took care of Nemu, Sakura and me, taking the place of
our parents who were working all the time.

dialogues.jp:
俺と同じように、手から和菓子を生み出すこと
が出来た――。
dialogues.en:
She was able to produce Japanese sweets from her hand just
like me.
dialogues.text:
She was able to produce Japanese sweets from her hand just
like me.

dialogues.jp: 自称魔法使いのばあちゃん。
dialogues.en: She called herself a witch grandma.
dialogues.text: She called herself a witch grandma.

dialogues.jp:
今思えば、あれは冗談ではなかったのかも知れ
ない。
dialogues.en: Thinking about it now, maybe she wasn't joking.
dialogues.text: Thinking about it now, maybe she wasn't joking.

dialogues.jp: もう確かめる術はないが。
dialogues.en: But there's no way to know that now.
dialogues.text: But there's no way to know that now.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、さくらがあんな顔するなんて、珍し
　いもんだな」
dialogues.en: "It's so unusual for Sakura to look like that."
dialogues.text: "It's so unusual for Sakura to look like that."

dialogues.jp:
感傷の邪魔をしては悪いと思って、静かにさく
らの側を離れる。
dialogues.en:
I left Sakura alone since she seemed to be overwhelmed by
sentiment.
dialogues.text:
I left Sakura alone since she seemed to be overwhelmed by
sentiment.

dialogues.jp:
特になにか目を惹く物もなく、なんとなく、今
朝の夢が気になって木の裏を覗き込んでしまう。
dialogues.en:
There was nothing to look at, and I kept thinking about the
dream I had this morning. I decided to look behind the tree.
dialogues.text:
There was nothing to look at, and I kept thinking about the
dream I had this morning. I decided to look behind the tree.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、ことり？」
dialogues.en: "Wow, Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Wow, Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい。こんにちは朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Uh, yes. Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Uh, yes. Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
居ないだろうと思っていた人物が、まるっきり
普通に笑顔を振りまいてくれる。
dialogues.en:
I didn't think she would really be here, but she was smiling
at me like she was supposed to be there.
dialogues.text:
I didn't think she would really be here, but she was smiling
at me like she was supposed to be there.

dialogues.jp: 「久しぶり。今日は歌ってなかったんだな」
dialogues.en: "Hey. You aren't singing today?"
dialogues.text: "Hey. You aren't singing today?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はい。そんな四六時中、ずっと歌っているわ
　けじゃありませんから」
dialogues.en: "That's right. It's not like I sing 24/7."
dialogues.text: "That's right. It's not like I sing 24/7."

dialogues.jp:
クスクス、と手にしていた文庫本を閉じて、こ
とりは悪戯っぽく笑う。
dialogues.en: Kotori giggled, closing the book she was reading.
dialogues.text: Kotori giggled, closing the book she was reading.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「音夢さんとは仲直りできたみたいですね」
dialogues.en: "So you made up with Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "So you made up with Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、まぁ……ぼちぼち」

そう言えば、あの公園でキスするところを見ら
れていたのを思い出す。
dialogues.en:
I remembered that she saw me kissing Nemu at the park the
other day.
dialogues.text:
I remembered that she saw me kissing Nemu at the park the
other day.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、あまりその辺は聞かないでくれ。心臓
　に悪い」
dialogues.en:
"Well, don't ask me too many questions on that subject. It's
not good for my heart."
dialogues.text:
"Well, don't ask me too many questions on that subject. It's
not good for my heart."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ふふふ……お似合いでしたからそんなに恥ず
　かしがらなくてもいいですよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't be shy. You guys looked great together."
dialogues.text: "Don't be shy. You guys looked great together."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「むしろ、美春ちゃんのほうが大変――」
dialogues.en: "But talk about how Miharu-chan was......"
dialogues.text: "But talk about how Miharu-chan was......"

dialogues.jp: と、急にことりの顔から笑みが消える。
dialogues.en: Then, Kotori stopped smiling.
dialogues.text: Then, Kotori stopped smiling.

dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！？」
dialogues.en: "Meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりの視線を追って振り向くと、いつの間に
か背中に立っていたさくらが手を振ってバラン
スを崩していた。
dialogues.en:
I followed her eyes and turned around to find Sakura
standing behind me. She was trying to wave but she lost her
balance.
dialogues.text:
I followed her eyes and turned around to find Sakura
standing behind me. She was trying to wave but she lost her
balance.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「わわっ、なんで急に振り向くの？」
dialogues.en: "Wow! Why did you turn around so fast like that?"
dialogues.text: "Wow! Why did you turn around so fast like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんでって、驚かそうとしてたのかお前？」
dialogues.en: "Why? Were you trying to scare me?"
dialogues.text: "Why? Were you trying to scare me?"

dialogues.jp:
倒れそうになったさくらの手を掴んで支え起こ
す。
dialogues.en: I grabbed her hand as she was falling and supported her.
dialogues.text: I grabbed her hand as she was falling and supported her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「違うよ、ボクは――白河さん？」
dialogues.en: "No, I was just...... Shirakawa-san?"
dialogues.text: "No, I was just...... Shirakawa-san?"

dialogues.jp:
ちょん、と俺の腰に抱きつくように顔をだしな
がら、さくらがことりを見て驚く。
dialogues.en:
Sakura seems to be surprised to find Kotori there as she
hugged my waist and saw her behind me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura seems to be surprised to find Kotori there as she
hugged my waist and saw her behind me.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりとも、なんとも言えない雰囲気で視線を
交わしてからぎこちなく笑った。
dialogues.en: They looked at each other funny, and smiled awkwardly.
dialogues.text: They looked at each other funny, and smiled awkwardly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは芳乃さん」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Yoshino-san."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Yoshino-san."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、久しぶり」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. Hi."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. Hi."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうか、ふたり共クラスメイトだっけ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you guys are in the same class?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, you guys are in the same class?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「元クラスメイト」
dialogues.en: "Used to be......"
dialogues.text: "Used to be......"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ええ。そっか、今日音夢さんは風紀委員の会
　議だったね」
dialogues.en:
"Right. Nemu has the school committee meeting today, doesn't
she?"
dialogues.text:
"Right. Nemu has the school committee meeting today, doesn't
she?"

dialogues.jp: 木から背中をはなして、ことりが薄く微笑む。
dialogues.en: Kotori raised herself from the tree and smiled.
dialogues.text: Kotori raised herself from the tree and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっとふたりでいるところを見たかったか
　な。凄く幸せそうできれいだったよ」
dialogues.en:
"I wanted to see you two together. You guys looked really
happy together."
dialogues.text:
"I wanted to see you two together. You guys looked really
happy together."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……幸せそう」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、まぁ、とりあえずその話はおいておい
　て。どうするさくら、一緒に飯でも食いに
　行くか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, enough with that subject. So, what do you want to do,
Sakura? Do you want to go grab some lunch with me?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, enough with that subject. So, what do you want to do,
Sakura? Do you want to go grab some lunch with me?"

dialogues.jp:
あまり心地よい話題ではないので、よいしょ、
と荷物をどかす古めかしいジェスチャーでさく
らに話をふる。
dialogues.en:
It felt uncomfortable, so I made a gesture to stop the
subject right there and talked to Sakura instead to change
the subject.
dialogues.text:
It felt uncomfortable, so I made a gesture to stop the
subject right there and talked to Sakura instead to change
the subject.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん、ボクはいいけど」
dialogues.en: "......Sure, I don't mind."
dialogues.text: "......Sure, I don't mind."

dialogues.jp: 俺を見上げた視線が、そのままことりに向いた。
dialogues.en: She looked up to me and then she looked at Kotori.
dialogues.text: She looked up to me and then she looked at Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい朝倉君、私がちょっと用事があ
　るから」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, Asakura-kun. But I already have plans."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, Asakura-kun. But I already have plans."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そっか。残念。じゃあまた今度だな」
dialogues.en: "That's too bad. Maybe next time."
dialogues.text: "That's too bad. Maybe next time."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか余所余所しいふたりが気になって、つ
いつい調子良く肩をすくめてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I didn't know why they were acting awkwardly to each other,
and why I was acting silly.
dialogues.text:
I didn't know why they were acting awkwardly to each other,
and why I was acting silly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん。期待して待ってるから。バイバイ。芳
　乃さんもまたね」
dialogues.en: "Okay. I look forward to next time. Bye. Bye, Yoshino-san."
dialogues.text: "Okay. I look forward to next time. Bye. Bye, Yoshino-san."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「グッバイ」
dialogues.en: "Goodbye."
dialogues.text: "Goodbye."

dialogues.jp: にぱにぱ、と満面の笑みでさくらが答える。
dialogues.en: Sakura answered with a smile.
dialogues.text: Sakura answered with a smile.

dialogues.jp:
と、去りかけたことりが、その姿を見て足を止
めた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori looked at Sakura smiling and stopped walking as she
was about to leave.
dialogues.text:
Kotori looked at Sakura smiling and stopped walking as she
was about to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「芳乃さん……あの」
dialogues.en: "Yoshino-san...... Uh..."
dialogues.text: "Yoshino-san...... Uh..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あのね……」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah?"

dialogues.jp:
なにか考え込んで、ことりがゆっくりと唇を動
かす。
dialogues.en:
Kotori moved her lips slowly as she was thinking about
something.
dialogues.text:
Kotori moved her lips slowly as she was thinking about
something.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ううん。なんでもないよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, never mind......"
dialogues.text: "Well, never mind......"

dialogues.jp:
優雅に首を振り、ことりが小さくスキップを踏
みながら背中を向ける。
dialogues.en: Kotori shook her head elegantly, and turned around.
dialogues.text: Kotori shook her head elegantly, and turned around.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんかお前、ことりに避けられてないか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, why is she avoiding you?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, why is she avoiding you?"

dialogues.jp: 耳元で｛ささや／囁｝く。
dialogues.en: I whispered in her ear.
dialogues.text: I whispered in her ear.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクはなんでもないんだけど、白河さんはボ
　クが苦手らしくて」
dialogues.en: "I don't know why, but she finds me hard to get along with."
dialogues.text: "I don't know why, but she finds me hard to get along with."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、なるほど……なるほどな」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see...... I see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see...... I see."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんな真剣に納得しないで――」
dialogues.en: "Why does it make sense to you?"
dialogues.text: "Why does it make sense to you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん、ちょい待て。電話だ」
dialogues.en: "Hold on. A phone call."
dialogues.text: "Hold on. A phone call."

dialogues.jp: 着信を振動にしていた携帯が震えていた。
dialogues.en: My cell phone was vibrating to let me know I had a call.
dialogues.text: My cell phone was vibrating to let me know I had a call.

dialogues.jp: 「美春からだ……」
dialogues.en: "It's Miharu......"
dialogues.text: "It's Miharu......"

dialogues.jp:
電話の相手を確かめて首をかしげる。美春なら、
音夢と一緒に会議に出ているはずだが。
dialogues.en:
I tilted my head as I saw who was calling me. Miharu should
be in the meeting with Nemu right now.
dialogues.text:
I tilted my head as I saw who was calling me. Miharu should
be in the meeting with Nemu right now.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「わんこ」
dialogues.en: "Bow wow."
dialogues.text: "Bow wow."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ん、そうだ。にゃんこじゃなくてわんこだ
　……もしもし？」
dialogues.en: "Whatever...... Hello?"
dialogues.text: "Whatever...... Hello?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 『朝倉先輩、どこにいるんですかぁ！！』
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai, where are you???"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai, where are you???"

dialogues.jp: やたら早口に、美春の大きな声が耳をつらぬく。
dialogues.en: Miharu shouted out, talking very fast.
dialogues.text: Miharu shouted out, talking very fast.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ突然。どこって……」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean where?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean where?"

dialogues.jp: 少し電話を離して地面を確認する。
dialogues.en: I put the phone away a little and looked on the ground.
dialogues.text: I put the phone away a little and looked on the ground.

dialogues.jp: 「地球」
dialogues.en: "The mother earth?"
dialogues.text: "The mother earth?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 『ボケてる場合じゃないですよぉ〜』
dialogues.en: "Stop joking!"
dialogues.text: "Stop joking!"

dialogues.jp: 美春の真剣な声に、ピンと来るものがあった。
dialogues.en: "......Something happened to Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "......Something happened to Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: 「……もしかして音夢になにかあったのか？」
dialogues.en: I suddenly knew why she had called me.
dialogues.text: I suddenly knew why she had called me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぅあ」
dialogues.en: "Wow."
dialogues.text: "Wow."

dialogues.jp:
俺の真剣な声に、さくらがビクリと身体を震わ
せる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura shook her body as she was surprised by my serious
voice.
dialogues.text:
Sakura shook her body as she was surprised by my serious
voice.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
『そうですよ！　音夢先輩です！　音夢先輩が
　倒れちゃったんです！』
dialogues.en: "Nemu-sempai collapsed!"
dialogues.text: "Nemu-sempai collapsed!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「……分かった。今は公園にいるから、すぐに
　迎えに行く」
dialogues.en:
"I see. I'm at the park right now, so I'll be there in no
time."
dialogues.text:
"I see. I'm at the park right now, so I'll be there in no
time."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 『急いでくださいね！』
dialogues.en: "Hurry up!"
dialogues.text: "Hurry up!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「分かったよ。じゃあな」
dialogues.en: "I will, later."
dialogues.text: "I will, later."

dialogues.jp: 電話を切ろうとして――。
dialogues.en: As I was about to hang up the phone......
dialogues.text: As I was about to hang up the phone......

dialogues.jp: なにかおかしいことに気づいた。
dialogues.en: I noticed something funny.
dialogues.text: I noticed something funny.

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと待て美春。音夢が倒れるのなんて、
　そこまで珍しくはないだろう？　なんでそん
　なに慌ててるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Wait, Miharu. It's not so unusual for Nemu to collapse. Why
are you panicking?"
dialogues.text:
"Wait, Miharu. It's not so unusual for Nemu to collapse. Why
are you panicking?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 『あの……音夢先輩……血を……』
dialogues.en: "Well...... Nemu-sempai...... Blood......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... Nemu-sempai...... Blood......"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Blood?"
dialogues.text: "Blood?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「血？　……そんなはず……」
dialogues.en: "Blood? No way......"
dialogues.text: "Blood? No way......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「くそっ、すぐに行くからな！」
dialogues.en: "Shit, I'll be right there!"
dialogues.text: "Shit, I'll be right there!"

dialogues.jp: 電源を切って、さくらの肩を掴む。
dialogues.en: I hung up the phone and grabbed Sakura's shoulders.
dialogues.text: I hung up the phone and grabbed Sakura's shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「音夢ちゃん倒れたの！？」
dialogues.en: "Did Nemu-chan collapse?"
dialogues.text: "Did Nemu-chan collapse?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ああ……さくら、１００メートルを１０秒で
　走れるか？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah...... Sakura, can you run 100 meters in 10 seconds?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah...... Sakura, can you run 100 meters in 10 seconds?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あにゃ？　……５０メートルを１０秒でなら
　いけるよ」
dialogues.en: "Uh...... I can run 50 meters in 10 seconds."
dialogues.text: "Uh...... I can run 50 meters in 10 seconds."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「よし！　すまないが置いてくぞ」
dialogues.en: "Fine! Sorry but you stay here."
dialogues.text: "Fine! Sorry but you stay here."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！？　お兄ちゃ〜ん」
dialogues.en: "What? Oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "What? Oniichan!"

dialogues.jp:
背中に届く捨て猫が呼びかけてくるような鳴き
声は無視して、必死に足を動かす。
dialogues.en:
I ignored her crying (which sounded just like an abandoned
cat) and ran as fast as I could.
dialogues.text:
I ignored her crying (which sounded just like an abandoned
cat) and ran as fast as I could.

dialogues.jp:
茂みをほとんど折って進む形で、道無き植え込
みから公園へと出る。
dialogues.en: I broke out of the bushes and ran out in to the park.
dialogues.text: I broke out of the bushes and ran out in to the park.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁ……学園はこっちか」
dialogues.en: "Which way to school?"
dialogues.text: "Which way to school?"

dialogues.jp:
縁起でもないのに、今朝の音夢の笑顔が頭をよ
ぎる。
dialogues.en:
The image of Nemu smiling this morning crossed my mind. This
is such bad luck.
dialogues.text:
The image of Nemu smiling this morning crossed my mind. This
is such bad luck.

dialogues.jp: 「くそ……面倒くせぇ！」
dialogues.en: "Shit...... What a pain!"
dialogues.text: "Shit...... What a pain!"

dialogues.jp:
公園で散歩する人間達が、まるでスローモーショ
ンのようにのろのろと動いている。
dialogues.en: I saw people walking around the park in slow motion.
dialogues.text: I saw people walking around the park in slow motion.

dialogues.jp:
一直線に並んでいる人々をなぎ倒したいなどと
いう、｛よこしま／邪｝な考えを押し殺しつつ、公園を走りぬ
ける。
dialogues.en:
I ran through the park, being frustrated by all the people
just hanging out at the park.
dialogues.text:
I ran through the park, being frustrated by all the people
just hanging out at the park.

dialogues.jp:
ぐるっ、と普段とは違うわき道から桜並木に走
りこむ。
dialogues.en: I ran into the street which leads to school.
dialogues.text: I ran into the street which leads to school.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁはぁはぁ……！」
dialogues.en: "Huff, puff..."
dialogues.text: "Huff, puff..."

dialogues.jp:
心臓が今にも破裂しそうで、舌も口の中に張り
付きかかっている。
dialogues.en:
My heart was about to explode, and my tongue was stuck in my
mouth.
dialogues.text:
My heart was about to explode, and my tongue was stuck in my
mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「ん……くそっ……音夢！」
dialogues.en: "Oh, shit! Nemu!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, shit! Nemu!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、兄さん、やっほ♪」
dialogues.en: "Hey, niisan!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, niisan!"

dialogues.jp:
心配のあまりか、桜の木の下に音夢の幻を見て
しまう。
dialogues.en:
I saw an illusion of Nemu under the cherry tree. I must be
worrying about Nemu too much.
dialogues.text:
I saw an illusion of Nemu under the cherry tree. I must be
worrying about Nemu too much.

dialogues.jp: 「くそっ！」
dialogues.en: "Shit!"
dialogues.text: "Shit!"

dialogues.jp:
頭を振りつつ、その幻に惑わされないように駆
け抜ける。
dialogues.en:
I shook my head trying not to be bothered by the illusion
and ran through.
dialogues.text:
I shook my head trying not to be bothered by the illusion
and ran through.

dialogues.jp: 本当の音夢は保健室で寝ているはずだ！
dialogues.en: The real Nemu should be in the nurse's office at school.
dialogues.text: The real Nemu should be in the nurse's office at school.

dialogues.jp: 「待ってろよ音夢！」
dialogues.en: "I'll be right there, Nemu!"
dialogues.text: "I'll be right there, Nemu!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、待ってよ兄さ〜ん！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, wait. Niisan!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, wait. Niisan!"

dialogues.jp: ズザザザザザ――ッ！
dialogues.en: I managed to stopped running.
dialogues.text: I managed to stopped running.

dialogues.jp:
と、ブレーキだけでは止まりきれず、校門の柱
に足をかけてなんとか身体を押しとどめる。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't stop right away. I had to grab onto the school
gate to stop myself.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't stop right away. I had to grab onto the school
gate to stop myself.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁはぁはぁはぁ……はぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに、はぁはぁしてるの？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you panting like that?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you panting like that?"

dialogues.jp:
とてとて、と平和そのものの足取りで音夢が寄っ
てくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu walked to me, as peaceful as could be.
dialogues.text: Nemu walked to me, as peaceful as could be.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁはぁはぁはぁはぁ……？」
dialogues.en: "Huff, puff... What?"
dialogues.text: "Huff, puff... What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「４２．１９５キロ走り抜けたのに、ゴールが
　なかったような顔してるよ？」
dialogues.en:
"You look like you couldn't find the goal after running a
full marathon."
dialogues.text:
"You look like you couldn't find the goal after running a
full marathon."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁはぁはぁ……はぁ……え！？」
dialogues.en: "Huff... Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huff... Huh?"

dialogues.jp: ばっ、と音夢のスカートに手を伸ばす。
dialogues.en: I reached out to her skirt.
dialogues.text: I reached out to her skirt.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うわわわわ！　なにするの兄さん！　ダメだ
　よこんなところで！」
dialogues.en: "Wow! What are you doing in the middle of the street?"
dialogues.text: "Wow! What are you doing in the middle of the street?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「足がある……」
dialogues.en: "You have legs......"
dialogues.text: "You have legs......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ス、スス、スカートめくらなくったって、足
　は普通に見えてますぅ！」
dialogues.en: "Y-Y-You can see my legs without flipping my skirt!"
dialogues.text: "Y-Y-You can see my legs without flipping my skirt!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でも、ふとももが……」
dialogues.en: "But your thigh......"
dialogues.text: "But your thigh......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あのね……兄さん、脳に酸素がいってないん
　じゃないの！？」
dialogues.en: "Maybe you're not getting enough oxygen to your brain......"
dialogues.text: "Maybe you're not getting enough oxygen to your brain......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Are you really okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you really okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん本当に大丈夫？」
dialogues.en: "Wow...... What are you thinking? Why are you so upset?"
dialogues.text: "Wow...... What are you thinking? Why are you so upset?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Did you do something again? You can tell me the truth."
dialogues.text: "Did you do something again? You can tell me the truth."

dialogues.jp: なにがなんだか本気で頭がこんがらがる。
dialogues.en: "I thought you coughed up blood."
dialogues.text: "I thought you coughed up blood."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……あぁ、それ……それか」

なぜか頬を真っ赤にして、音夢が口元に手を当
てる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu covered her mouth with her hand as she blushed her
face.
dialogues.text:
Nemu covered her mouth with her hand as she blushed her
face.

dialogues.jp:
「美春から携帯電話に連絡があったんだぞ？
　だから俺は……」
dialogues.en: "So you did have your first period?"
dialogues.text: "So you did have your first period?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、えっとそれは……ごにょごにょ」
dialogues.en: "No. It's not that......"
dialogues.text: "No. It's not that......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ごにょごにょ、って自分で言うなよ」
dialogues.en: "Huh? I don't get it."
dialogues.text: "Huh? I don't get it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「分かりましたよぉ……恥ずかしい」
dialogues.en: "Okay, fine. I'm so embarrassed."
dialogues.text: "Okay, fine. I'm so embarrassed."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「その……は、鼻血……」
dialogues.en: "Ugh...... I had a nosebleed......"
dialogues.text: "Ugh...... I had a nosebleed......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「鼻血が出て、貧血になったのよ！」
dialogues.en: "I had a nosebleed and I had an attack of anemia."
dialogues.text: "I had a nosebleed and I had an attack of anemia."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、なんか反応してよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, how come you aren't saying anything?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, how come you aren't saying anything?"

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の危機！？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu faces a crisis?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu faces a crisis?◆

dialogues.jp:
さくらとのデートで公園を歩いている途中、美
春から音夢が血を吐いて倒れたと電話がかかっ
てきた。
dialogues.en:
I was walking at the park with Sakura when Miharu called me
and told me that Nemu had collapsed coughing up blood.
dialogues.text:
I was walking at the park with Sakura when Miharu called me
and told me that Nemu had collapsed coughing up blood.

dialogues.jp:
慌てて学園へと向かう俺だったが、音夢はた
だ鼻血を出して貧血になっただけだったらし
い……。
dialogues.en:
I raced to school but Nemu only had a nosebleed, and was a
little weak from anemia.
dialogues.text:
I raced to school but Nemu only had a nosebleed, and was a
little weak from anemia.

dialogues.jp:
安心というか、なんともいえない気分で息をは
く。
dialogues.en: I exhaled deeply, feeling something I couldn't describe.
dialogues.text: I exhaled deeply, feeling something I couldn't describe.
